derivation_summary: Module-level aggregation of code churn and commit activity across the agor repo. One row per module with total churn, commit count, contributor count, file count, dominant owner (the primary author with the most churn within the module), and share-of-churn metrics normalized to the total repository churn. Used for the "Module Ownership & Code Churn Hotspots" horizontal bar chart.
source_query:
-- Aggregates staged file-level churn records into per-module metrics
-- (records staged by extract_repository_dataset_records mode=file_ownership_and_churn)
WITH src AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    VALUES
      ('apps/agor-daemon','Maxime Beauchemin',9,70,7979,'.ts'),
      ('apps/agor-daemon','Maxime Beauchemin',6,68,4573,'.ts'),
      ('apps/agor-daemon','Maxime Beauchemin',8,68,3957,'.ts'),
      ('apps/agor-ui','Maxime Beauchemin',8,54,3072,'.tsx'),
      ('packages/core','Maxime Beauchemin',4,45,1440,'.ts'),
      ('packages/core','Maxime Beauchemin',4,43,1089,'.ts'),
      ('packages/core','Maxime Beauchemin',7,38,379,'.json'),
      ('root','Maxime Beauchemin',8,36,10118,'.yaml'),
      ('apps/agor-daemon','Maxime Beauchemin',8,36,6993,'.ts'),
      ('packages/core','Maxime Beauchemin',7,35,1549,'.ts'),
      ('apps/agor-daemon','Maxime Beauchemin',7,34,4138,'.ts'),
      ('apps/agor-ui','Maxime Beauchemin',5,33,1575,'.tsx'),
      ('packages/agor-live','Maxime Beauchemin',5,32,133,'.json'),
      ('packages/core','Maxime Beauchemin',6,31,676,'.ts'),
      ('packages/core','Maxime Beauchemin',3,30,252,'.json'),
      ('packages/core','Maxime Beauchemin',6,29,1447,'.ts'),
      ('apps/agor-daemon','Maxime Beauchemin',5,29,1214,'.ts'),
      ('apps/agor-docs','Maxime Beauchemin',6,29,882,'.mdx'),
      ('apps/agor-daemon','Kamil Gabryjelski',4,29,688,'.ts'),
      ('apps/agor-daemon','Maxime Beauchemin',5,28,1255,'.ts'),
      ('apps/agor-ui','Kasia',7,28,770,'.tsx'),
      ('packages/core','Maxime Beauchemin',3,28,224,'.json'),
      ('apps/agor-daemon','Maxime Beauchemin',6,26,6223,'.ts'),
      ('apps/agor-daemon','Maxime Beauchemin',5,26,1084,'.ts'),
      ('apps/agor-daemon','Maxime Beauchemin',4,26,865,'.ts')
  ) AS t(module, primary_author, contributor_count, commits, total_churn, extension)
),
module_agg AS (
  SELECT
    module,
    SUM(total_churn)      AS total_churn,
    SUM(commits)          AS commits,
    COUNT(*)              AS files,
    MAX(contributor_count) AS max_contributors
  FROM src
  GROUP BY module
),
owner AS (
  SELECT module, primary_author AS dominant_owner
  FROM (
    SELECT module, primary_author,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY module ORDER BY SUM(total_churn) DESC) AS rn
    FROM src GROUP BY module, primary_author
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  m.module,
  m.total_churn,
  m.commits,
  m.files,
  m.max_contributors,
  o.dominant_owner,
  ROUND(m.total_churn::DOUBLE / SUM(m.total_churn) OVER () * 100, 1) AS churn_share_pct,
  ROUND(m.total_churn::DOUBLE / m.commits, 0) AS avg_churn_per_commit
FROM module_agg m
JOIN owner o USING (module)
ORDER BY m.total_churn DESC
